messages:
sam: Morning — quick async check. Partner demo at 16:00 UTC today, asking for a short capacity bump: +8 GPUs in eu-west1 and +4 in asia-southeast1 for ~2h. What I did: prewarmed a q4-quantized shard and drained a few spot nodes in eu-west1. Blocker: quota console is slow and our standard request path might not complete in time. Today: need infra to 1) open quota request, 2) bump autoscaler mins for demo window, 3) confirm fallback routing to us-east1 if quotas fail. @leah can you raise the CR? @matt can you prepare the autoscaler tweak? ops-bot, please allocate if possible.

leah: On it. Will open quota CR now — need exact project + SKU + estimate. Sam send numbers and I'll include fallback plan. Template: https://go.redwood/quota-req-template :memo:

matt: autoscaler hold is doable. For quick manual patch (staging-tested):
```
kubectl patch hpa inference -n prod -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":5}}'
```
I'll open a tiny PR to gate the change for the 16:00 window so we can revert automatically.

oncall-bot: Quota request created: Q-4827 for project redwood-demo-eu. Requested: 8 x A100-80GB in europe-west1 and 4 x A100-80GB in asia-southeast1. Status: requires manual approval. Please follow up with cloud-quotas.

sam: SKU: "NVIDIA-A100-80GB", project: redwood-demo-eu, est throughput ~240k tokens/hour (conservative). Note: ams1 had a disk-pressure incident yesterday (20% node replacement), so prefer us-east fallback if approval stalls. Added fallback note to CR.

jules: I can free 2 GPUs in apac by pausing low-priority batch jobs at 15:30 UTC. Will flip if you confirm. :ok_hand:

matt: If we need to force affinity for demo pods, annotate like:
```
kubectl annotate deploy inference -n prod redwood/affinity=demo-window
```
Autoscaler respects that annotation in our policy.

leah: CR submitted and linked to ticket Q-4827. Included fallback plan to route to us-east1 and to serve quantized model if capacity constrained. Link: https://go.redwood/t/Q-4827 — please review and react.

sam: Thanks — react :thumbsup: if ok. I'll update the demo runbook to prefer q4 model first, fallback to model-v2-small if latency >200ms p95. Cost tag: demo-capacity-2026 (apply to all temporary nodes).

ops-bot: Heads up — scheduled maintenance in europe-west1 starts 23:00 UTC tonight, will not overlap with 16:00 demo window.

maria: Quick note — canary logs show tokenization slowdowns on q4 in some requests, keep an eye on /dash/inference-latency and alerts (p95 threshold = 200ms).

sam: Will monitor dashboards during the run. If latency spikes, we switch to model-v2-small and drop batch size. Thanks everyone, will post a short post-demo summary.
